Title: Generally Available: Entry-Level Tiers (M10/M20) with vCore-Based Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB

Body.Content:
We’re making it easier for you to get started with vCore-based Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB by introducing support for M10 and M20 tiers. Now, you can build and scale your applications at a lower starting cost while enjoying the flexibility and performance of a fully managed database. 

Learn more.
